question:
In the following bar diagram, there are 5 companies A, B, C, D and E. The diagram shows the demand of a product and its production the above five companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeb3fbe26ec6fcdb96a5ffa1d87a20635e68be43e16705149d1a402d4fc3dcd7.png] 

If x% of the demand of the product by Company C is equal to that of the Company B, then find the value of x.
solution:
Calculation:

​According to the question,

x% × 2500 = 600

⇒ x% = 24

∴ The value of x is 24.
